en.title: Global Macro — Strong U.S. equipment demand collides with a 5% long-rate regime
en.deck: August capital-goods orders show a resilient U.S. equipment-investment cycle even as long real and nominal yields remain restrictive and household inflation expectations rise.
en.regime: Selective investment strength under expensive capital: equipment demand remains firm while long real and nominal yields stay restrictive and household confidence weakens.
en.key_risk: If high real yields persist while the investment boom remains concentrated, financing pressure can spread beyond housing and weaker borrowers before productivity gains broaden enough to offset it.
watch: Breadth of U.S. equipment investment beyond AI-linked categories
U.S. 10-year and 30-year nominal and real yields
Credit spreads, issuance quality and project cancellations
Verified Hormuz throughput, freight, insurance and Gulf export logistics

pt-BR.title: Global Macro — Investimento forte em equipamentos nos EUA colide com um regime de juros longos acima de 5%
pt-BR.deck: Os pedidos de bens de capital de agosto mostram um ciclo resiliente de investimento em equipamentos nos EUA enquanto juros nominais e reais longos continuam restritivos e as expectativas de inflação das famílias sobem.
pt-BR.regime: Força seletiva do investimento sob capital caro: a demanda por equipamentos permanece firme enquanto juros nominais e reais longos seguem restritivos e a confiança das famílias piora.
pt-BR.key_risk: Se juros reais elevados persistirem enquanto o boom de investimento continuar concentrado, a pressão de financiamento pode se espalhar além da habitação e dos tomadores mais fracos antes que ganhos de produtividade se difundam o suficiente para compensá-la.
watch: Amplitude do investimento em equipamentos dos EUA além das categorias associadas à IA
Treasuries nominais e reais de 10 e 30 anos
Spreads de crédito, qualidade das emissões e cancelamentos de projetos
Expectativas de inflação de Michigan e de mercado
Fluxo físico verificado por Ormuz, frete, seguros e logística de exportação do Golfo

novelty_gate.dominant_delta: The August durable-goods release arrived after the September 25 daily: core U.S. capital-goods orders rose 1.6% and shipments 0.6%, showing realized equipment-investment strength even as official 10-year and 30-year Treasury yields closed at 5.17% and 5.49%.
novelty_gate.repetition_control: The report does not reuse high long yields or equity resilience as the lead. It treats them as the financing environment for the newly observed capital-goods/household divergence and keeps Gulf diplomacy separate from verified physical normalization.
